content.user_title: Create Handovers With One Clear Resume Point
content.value_statement: Scattered progress notes leave successors uncertain about evidence, pending work, and the next action. This skill creates structured handovers with versioned evidence and clear resume conditions.
actual_capabilities: Organize handovers into acceptance goals, current state, finished evidence, ordered remaining work, and recovery information.
Bind evidence to its version and coverage, distinguishing historical checks from missing or failed checks.
Separate ready, paused, cancelled, and unknown work while ordering prerequisites before dependent checks.
Define one first action with an object and completion signal, or name an exact waiting event.
Preserve original request metadata and recommend a read-only lookup or bounded wait instead of replaying unknown requests.
Record supplied backup locations and restore triggers, explicitly marking missing information without inventing recovery details.
limitations: Evidence quality depends on supplied records; the skill does not independently verify artifacts or execution outcomes.
It does not execute remaining work, restore backups, or resend interrupted requests.
It cannot supply missing acceptance criteria, file locations, request metadata, or backup records.
It provides workflow instructions, not a standalone task tracker or monitoring service.

use_cases.title: Transfer a revised document for review
use_cases.description: Identify which historical checks still apply and specify the first preview needed for a changed component.

use_cases.title: Hand over interrupted operations
use_cases.description: Separate independent ready work from paused requests and retain original identifiers for checking unknown outcomes without duplicate submissions.

use_cases.title: Transfer ownership between contributors
use_cases.description: Consolidate updates into versioned evidence, ordered dependencies, recovery conditions, and explicit closure for accepted work.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic handover
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a handover from these notes: [notes]. State the goal, current status, first action, and completion signal. Mark missing facts as not provided.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: turn existing notes into a first handover.

prompt_templates.title: Scope evidence after a revision
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a handover from [revision notes] and [review evidence]. Separate unchanged coverage from new checks. Name the first preview action and supplied recovery conditions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: transfer a partially reviewed revision.

prompt_templates.title: Transfer a request with unknown effects
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [shift notes] to hand over ready work and a paused request with an unknown outcome. Preserve original request metadata. Specify a read-only lookup or bounded wait, without resending.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: transfer interrupted operations without duplicate effects.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile a complex ownership transfer
prompt_templates.prompt: Reconcile [prior handover], [current updates], and [acceptance evidence]. Replace only superseded facts, order dependencies, and remove cancelled actions. Close accepted work and preserve unknown request identities. Document backup gaps without executing remaining work.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: consolidate multiple updates into one actionable handover.

output_examples.input: Revision r7 changes only the cover. Body checks passed for r6. The r7 PDF has not been previewed. The recorded cover backup is available.
output: Goal: r7 renders without a clipped title. State: not done; preview pending.
Evidence: the r6 body review supports unchanged body content, not the r7 cover.
First action: open the r7 PDF. Complete when the cover is visible and title clipping can be judged.
Recovery: use the recorded cover backup only if the supplied clipping trigger occurs. Exact backup location: not provided.

output_examples.input: Report r3 totals passed. The staging index can update independently. Import im-42 timed out at 14:10 UTC with checksum f7a. Imports are paused until the window reopens. The duplicate export is cancelled.
output: State: not done. Report r3 totals passed; evidence location not provided.
First action: update the staging index. Complete when it lists r3.
Import im-42: paused until the window reopens; outcome unknown. Target: staging. Timeout: 14:10 UTC. Checksum: f7a. Submit time: not provided.
After reopening: check the original request once in its status view. If unavailable, retain unknown. Do not resend.
Duplicate export: cancelled and removed from the queue. Recovery details: not provided.

output_examples.input: The deliverable meets all supplied acceptance criteria. No required work remains. Suggested visual refinements are optional.
output: Resume point: Done, no next action.
Optional refinements are not queued as required handover work.

best_practices: Provide current revision details, acceptance criteria, and evidence locations before requesting the handover.
Keep original request identifiers, targets, timestamps, and submitted fingerprints when an operation has an unknown outcome.
Record actual backup locations and explicit restore triggers; mark unavailable facts as not provided.
anti_patterns: Treating historical checks as proof that a changed component passed a fresh review.
Resending a timed-out request before reconciling the original attempt.
Inventing paths, backup records, or acceptance criteria to make the handover appear complete.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces a structured handover with goals, state, scoped evidence, ordered remaining work, a resume point, and recovery details.

faq.question: Does it perform the remaining work?
faq.answer: No. It documents remaining actions and recovery conditions without executing them. If draft and submit tools are provided, it instructs delivery of the note.

faq.question: How does it handle missing information?
faq.answer: It marks missing facts as not provided rather than inventing them. Confirmed absence of a backup is recorded as none.

faq.question: Can an older review support a newer revision?
faq.answer: Yes, for unchanged content within the recorded scope. It cannot prove that a changed component or new preview passed.

faq.question: What happens when a request times out?
faq.answer: The handover preserves its original identity and unknown outcome. It specifies a read-only lookup or bounded wait, not a resend.

faq.question: Which languages are included?
faq.answer: The package includes English and Chinese workflows with templates, worked examples, and checklists.
